CITY COUNCIL MEETING
AGENDA FOR LA MIRADA CITY COUNCIL MEETING
June 8, 2021 –
6:30
p.m.
COUNCIL CHAMBERS, CITY HALL, 13700 LA MIRADA BOULEVARD,
LA MIRADA, CALIFORNIA 90638
In-Person Public Participation Information
To address the City Council on an Agenda item other than a Public Hearing or during Public
Comments, please fill out a "Request to Address Council" card located in the back of the Council
Chambers near the agendas and submit to the City Clerk prior to the meeting or as soon as
possible. There is a five minute maximum time limit when addressing the City Council. The amount
of time for public comment may be reduced by the Mayor or by action of the City Council
Electronic Public Participation
To submit your Public Comments electronically in advance, please email your written comments to
cityclerk@lamirada.gov. The deadline to submit your Public Comment electronically is on the day
of a regular City Council meeting before 3 p.m. For special meetings, comments must be received
at least three hours prior to the meeting.
Members of the public may participate in this meeting via remote attendance by using the Zoom
Webinar information.
Zoom Meeting Details: www.zoom.us/join
Meeting ID: 897 8121 0338 Telephone Option: 1-669-444-9171
(*6 to unmute; *9 to raise hand)
Public Comment will begin with speakers attending in-person first followed by those attending via
Zoom Webinar.
Reasonable Accommodations
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, if you need special assistance to participate
in a City Council meeting or other service offered by the City, contact the City Clerk's Office at
(562) 943-0131. Notification at least 48 hours prior to the meeting or time when services are
needed will assist City staff in assuring that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide
accessibility to the meeting or service.
Agenda Materials
Copies of staff reports and supporting documentation pertaining to agenda items are available for
public viewing and inspection at City Hall during regular business hours and on the City's website
http://www.lamirada.gov. For further information regarding agenda items, please contact the
City Clerk's office at (562) 943-0131.

APPOINTMENTS
6.1
REAPPOINTMENTS AND APPOINTMENTS TO ADVISORY BODIES – It is recommended the City Council reappoint Diane Albert, Larry McCollum, Peggy Roman, Tom Rosholt, Aracely Ruiz, Millicent Eugena Thomas, Lawrence Torres, and Martha Viayra to the Senior Council for terms expiring in June 30, 2023; reappoint Marlene Olsen, Gail Pearce, Dr. C. David Peters, Harry Scott, Beverly Sutherland, and Stephen Thrasher to the Historical Preservation Advisory Council for terms expiring in June 30, 2023; appoint Desiree Johnson to the Community Services Commission for a term expiring in June 2024; and appoint Michelle Lynch to the Public Safety Commission for a term expiring in June 2024.
6.1 Reappointments and Appointments
7.
CONSENT CALENDAR
7.1
APPROVAL OF MEETING MINUTES - It is recommended the City Council approve the minutes of the Special meeting of May 21,2021 and the minutes of the regular City Council meeting of May 25, 2021.
7.1 Minutes of 5-21-21 Special Meeting
7.1 Minutes of 5-25-21 Council Meeting
7.2
APPROVAL OF WARRANT REGISTER - It is recommended the City Council approve the warrant register dated June 8, 2021 in the total amount of $1,714,395.24.
7.2 Warrant Register - City
7.3
MONTHLY TREASURER REPORT FOR THE PERIOD ENDING FEBRUARY 2021 - It is recommended the City Council receive and file the City of La Mirada Monthly Treasurer Report for the period ending February 2021.
7.3 Treasurer Report - February 2021
7.4
MONTHLY TREASURER REPORT FOR THE PERIOD ENDING MARCH 2021 - It is recommended the City Council receive and file the City of La Mirada Monthly Treasurer Report for the period ending March 2021.
7.4 Treasurer Report - March
7.5
INVESTMENT REPORT FOR THE CITY OF LA MIRADA FOR THE MONTH ENDING APRIL 2021 – It is recommended the City Council receive and file the City’s Investment Report for the month ending April 2021.
7.5 Investment Report
7.6
INDEPENDENT ACCOUNTANTS’ REPORT ON AGREED-UPON PROCEDURES APPLIED TO APPROPRIATIONS LIMIT WORKSHEETS FOR FISCAL YEAR 2020-21 - It is recommended the City Council receive and file the Independent Accountants’ Report on Agreed-Upon Procedures Applied to Appropriations Limit Worksheets.
7.6 Independent Accountants' Report
7.7
CAPITAL IMPROVEMENT PROJECT NO. 2021-07, SLURRY SEAL OF SANTA GERTRUDES AVENUE FROM LEMON DRIVE TO LA MIRADA BOULEVARD AND HILLSBOROUGH DRIVE FROM ALICANTE ROAD TO BEACH BOULEVARD - APPROVAL OF PLANS AND SPECIFICATIONS - It is recommended the City Council find that pursuant to the California Environmental Quality Act of 1970, the project is categorically exempt under Section 15301 Class 1 (c) and will have no significant effect on the environment; approve the plans and specifications for Capital Improvement Project No. 2021-07, Slurry Seal of Santa Gertrudes Avenue from Lemon Drive to La Mirada Boulevard and Hillsborough Drive from Alicante Road to Beach Boulevard; and authorize the City Clerk to advertise for sealed bids.
7.7 CIP No. 2021-07
7.8
CAPITAL IMPROVEMENT PROJECT NO. 2021-03 CITY HALL CARPET REPLACEMENT – REVIEW OF BIDS AND AWARD OF CONTRACT - It is recommended the City Council award the contract for Capital Improvement Project No. 2021-03, City Hall Carpet Replacement, to Commercial Interior Resources in the amount of $93,420.00; authorize the City Manager to execute the contract on behalf of the City; and authorize the City Manager to approve additional work up to 20 percent of the total project cost.
7.8 CIP No. 2021-03
7.9
CAPITAL IMPROVEMENT PROJECT NO. 2021-06, PARKING LOT SEAL COAT FOR CITY FACILITIES – CIVIC CENTER, BEHRINGER PARK, FRONTIER PARK, VETERANS PARK, WINDERMERE PARK, NEFF PARK, CREEK PARK, GARDENHILL PARK, WILDERNESS AREA, PUBLIC WORKS WAREHOUSE, THEATRE WAREHOUSE, TRANSIT FACILITY, AND 14515 ALONDRA BOULEVARD - APPROVAL OF PLANS AND SPECIFICATIONS - It is recommended the City Council find that pursuant to the California Environmental Quality Act of 1970, the project is categorically exempt under Section 15301 Class 1 (c) and will have no significant effect on the environment; approve the plans and specifications for Capital Improvement Project No. 2021-06, Parking Lot Seal Coat for City Facilities – Civic Center, Behringer Park, Frontier Park, Veterans Park, Windermere Park, Neff Park, Creek Park, Gardenhill Park, Wilderness Area, Public Works Warehouse, Theatre Warehouse, Transit Facility, and 14515 Alondra Boulevard; and authorize the City Clerk to advertise for sealed bids.
7.9 CIP No. 2021-06
7.10
CAPITAL IMPROVEMENT PROJECT NO. 2018-08, PHASE 6B, RESIDENTIAL STREET REHABILITATION - APPROVAL OF PLANS AND SPECIFICATIONS - It is recommended the City Council find that pursuant to the California Environmental Quality Act of 1970, the project is categorically exempt under Section 15301 Class 1 (c) and will have no significant effect on the environment; approve plans and specifications for Capital Improvement Project No. 2018-08, Phase 6B, Residential Street Rehabilitation; and authorize the City Clerk to advertise for sealed bids.
7.10 CIP No. 2018-08
7.11
CAPITAL IMPROVEMENT PROJECT NO. 2021-05, NEIGHBORHOOD SLURRY SEAL AREA 3 - APPROVAL OF AMENDMENT TO THE ON-CALL PROFESSIONAL/TECHNICAL SERVICES AGREEMENT TO HARRIS & ASSOCIATES FOR PROFESSIONAL ENGINEERING DESIGN SERVICES - It is recommended the City Council accept the proposal from Harris & Associates for professional engineering design services in the amount of $35,550; authorize the City Manager to approve an amendment to the existing On-Call Professional/Technical Services Agreement for professional engineering design services to Harris & Associates in the amount of $35,550; and authorize the City Manager to approve additional professional services, if required, to Harris & Associates for up to 20 percent of the authorized contract amount.
7.11 CIP No. 2021-05
8.
PUBLIC HEARING
8.1
RESOLUTION NO. 21-15 APPROVING A RATE ADJUSTMENT FOR REFUSE SERVICE AND ESTABLISHING RESIDENTIAL AND COMMERCIAL REFUSE RATES IN THE CITY OF LA MIRADA EFFECTIVE JULY 1, 2021, AND RESOLUTION NO. 21-16 APPROVING A RATE ADJUSTMENT FOR REFUSE SERVICE AND ESTABLISHING RESIDENTIAL AND COMMERCIAL REFUSE RATES INCLUDING AN ORGANICS COLLECTION AND RECYCLING PROGRAM IN THE CITY OF LA MIRADA EFFECTIVE JANUARY 1, 2022 - It is recommended the City Council conduct a public hearing as prescribed by law; adopt Resolution No. 21-15 approving the proposed rate adjustment and establishing residential and commercial refuse rates in the City of La Mirada effective July 1, 2021; and adopt Resolution No. 21-16 approving the proposed rate adjustment and establishing residential and commercial refuse rates including an Organic Collection and Recycling Program in the City of La Mirada effective January 1, 2022.
8.1 PH: Residential and Commercial Refuse Rates
8.2
RESOLUTION NO. 21-17 ADOPTING THE PROPOSED FISCAL YEAR 2021-22 BUDGET - It is recommended the City Council conduct a Public Hearing as prescribed by law and adopt Resolution No. 21-17 approving the Proposed Fiscal Year 2021-22 Budget.
8.2 PH: Resolution No. 21-17 FY 2021-22 Budget
8.3
RESOLUTION NO. 21-18 APPROVING THE SUBMISSION OF AWARD TERMS AND CONDITIONS FOR AMERICAN RESCUE PLAN ACT OF 2021 (ARPA) AND THE GRANT PROGRAM FOR SHUTTERED VENUE OPERATORS - It is recommended the City Council adopt Resolution No. 21-18 approving the City's submission of award terms and conditions for American Rescue Plan Act of 2021 (ARPA) and the Grant Program for Shuttered Venue Operators and authorize the City Manager to execute all documents.
8.3 PH: Resolution No. 21-18
9.
ORDINANCES AND RESOLUTIONS
9.1
RESOLUTION NO. 21-19 ESTABLISHING THE APPROPRIATIONS LIMIT FOR FISCAL YEAR 2021-22 - It is recommended the City Council select the percentage change in the non-residential new construction as the inflation factor for Fiscal Year 2021-22; select the growth of the City as the population factor for Fiscal Year 2021-22; and adopt Resolution No. 21-19 establishing an Appropriations Limit for Fiscal Year 2021-22 pursuant to Article XIIIB of the California Constitution.
9.1 Resolution No. 21-19 Appropriations Limit
9.2
RESOLUTION NO. 21-20 REGARDING EMPLOYMENT BENEFITS AND SALARY RATES FOR ALL CLASSES OF EMPLOYMENT, AND SUPERSEDING RESOLUTION NO. 20-19 - It is recommended the City Council adopt Resolution No. 21-20 regarding employment benefits and salary rates for all classes of employment, and superseding Resolution No. 20-19.
9.2 Resolution No. 21-20 Reg. Employment Benefits
9.3
RESOLUTION NO. 21-21 REGARDING PAYING AND REPORTING THE VALUE OF EMPLOYER PAID MEMBER CONTRIBUTIONS TO THE CALIFORNIA PUBLIC EMPLOYEES' RETIREMENT SYSTEM - It is recommended the City Council adopt Resolution No. 21-21 regarding paying and reporting the value of employer paid member contributions to the California Public Employees' Retirement System.
9.3 Resolution No. 21-21 Reg. EPMC
9.4
RESOLUTION NO. 21-22 ADOPTING A PROJECT LIST FOR FISCAL YEAR 2021-22 FUNDED BY SB-1: THE ROAD REPAIR AND ACCOUNTABILITY ACT OF 2017 - It is recommended the City Council adopt Resolution No. 21-22 adopting a project list for Fiscal Year 2021-22 funded by SB-1 and authorize staff to submit the project list to the California Transportation Commission.
9.4 Resolution No. 21-22 Reg. SB-1 Projects
